messages:
jules: opened a small PR to clarify routing hints, cost vs latency tradeoffs, and fallback detection for mariner-4b model card. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6142

jules: problem: customers are confused about when to use 'prefer_variant' vs 'route_policy' and how to assert that streaming actually hit the selected variant (we surface a different metric set depending on where the fallback happened). asks: add a short compatibility row, a tiny bench line for the lite variants, and two tiny SDK examples showing explicit routing + runtime detection.

ari: +1. can you paste the current snippet you added and the lint warning? I'll tag runtime.

jules: pasted snippet (python) and lint output:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
resp = c.generate(
    model="mariner-4b",
    input="<very long prefix>",
    routing={"prefer_variant": "fp16-full"}
)
print(resp.output)
```

lint-bot: ERROR docs/guide/routing.md: anchor "routing-hints" already defined in docs/models/nebula-3b.md line 34.

pete: runtime note: there are two things we emit that are useful in docs: (1) routing.selected_variant — tells you the variant actually picked at routing time, and (2) kernel.fallback_reason — tells you if the kernel fell back after routing (e.g., out-of-memory on the selected device). we should recommend checking both in examples.

samira: bench I ran quick: mariner-4b-fp16-full p95 token latency @2k ctx = 120ms, mariner-4b-q4_cpu p95 = 480ms (when not falling back). if q4_cpu hits a disk-cache fallback tail latency grows ~3x. I'll add a tiny inline note in the model card.

jules: thanks — i'll add the bench lines. also i want to show a JS streaming example that demonstrates how to log selected_variant and fallback_reason on-the-fly. tentative JS snippet below. feedback welcome.
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient()
const stream = await client.stream({
  model: 'mariner-4b',
  routing: { prefer_variant: 'fp16-full', route_policy: 'latency_first' }
})
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  // chunk.meta is populated with routing/telemetry keys
  if (chunk.meta && chunk.meta['routing.selected_variant']) {
    console.log('selected variant:', chunk.meta['routing.selected_variant'])
  }
  if (chunk.meta && chunk.meta['kernel.fallback_reason']) {
    console.warn('runtime fallback:', chunk.meta['kernel.fallback_reason'])
  }
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
}
```

ari: tiny wording suggestion: prefer 'route_policy' values: 'latency_first', 'cost_first', or 'region_strict'. doc should show quick mapping table. also clarify that 'prefer_variant' is a hard preference but still allows safe fallbacks when 'allow_fallback' is true.

pete: runtime nit: 'prefer_variant' is advisory when used alone; if you set routing: { prefer_variant: 'fp16-full', allow_fallback: false } we'll fail the request rather than fallback. important to document because some apps expect deterministic behavior.

jules: added sentence: "If allow_fallback is false and the preferred variant is unavailable, the request will error instead of falling back." also added a compatibility row: "Streaming: for mariner-4b-q4_cpu variants, KV cache disabled at >8k; prefer fp16-full for long-context streaming to avoid disk-cache fallback and higher tail latency."

lint-bot: re-run: anchor duplicate fixed (moved model-specific anchor to docs/models/mariner-4b.md as mariner4b-routing-hints). one small markdown lint: heading-style in routing.md line 14.

docs-bot: preview deployed for PR #6142  https://deploy-preview.docs/6142  model card updated under "Compatibility & routing".

qa: smoke planned: i'll run both snippets and validate that resp.metadata/routing.selected_variant appears and that kernel.fallback_reason shows when we force a low-memory condition. will report back.

samira: quick follow-up: add a tiny troubleshooting FAQ bullet: how to detect and alert on unexpected fallbacks in production (e.g., record routing.selected_variant & kernel.fallback_reason in spans and alert on changes from expected variant).

jules: added the FAQ line and a link to the observability guide. assigning follow-ups: @qa smoke, @pete add a runtime changelog entry for routing.selected_variant, @samira confirm bench table formatting.

qa: smoke: python snippet runs; resp.metadata includes 'routing.selected_variant' and when we simulate low memory kernel.fallback_reason appears. JS snippet works in node 18+. leaving a tiny note about older node polyfills. LGTM.

pete: will add changelog line after merge.
